risk.rationale: Only verified evidence is F1: a single LIKELY (0.6) sign-in from an unseen device (PH-9900 vs usual LT-6002) for b.cetin@aegean.edu, mapped to T1078. The two password-spray-then-success claims are rejected: both source IPs (78.187.4.44, 193.140.10.17) are shared egress with 186 and 208 distinct accounts completing MFA in 30 days (threshold 10), so failures across many accounts are background noise, not a coordinated spray. No confirmed account takeover chain exists, no suspicious signal is explained away as benign, and there are no data-quality conflicts or exposure requiring human review. A new-device sign-in at LIKELY confidence is a weak unexplained signal, appropriate for monitoring.
